type: Semantic model, extraction snapshot and jsdom interaction tests; not rendered browser QA

Model rejects duplicate IDs, broken refs, fake source writeback and unmapped facts

Source snapshot links resolve to actual line anchors, thumbnails exist
Definition, placed instance, spawn marker and ephemeral rule stay distinct
Source values and behavior types are faithful
Migration preserves old values, unknown fields and original bytes
Every semantic definition and all 38 behavior views render without runtime errors
Player definition accessible from spawn independently of room, enemies include ranged placement
Type-specific panels do not force continuous/response/interaction into attack timeline
Read-only behavior fields and optional Narrative are honest
Coverage filter reaches inputs, state, resources, source pages and method
Legacy storage is not overwritten on load; reopening migrates explicitly, saving preserves backup
Phone semantic selection, coverage, DNA drawer and method close paths
